    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    n = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    sequence = [0]
    total_sum = 0
    results = []

    for _ in range(n):
        operation = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        if operation == 1:
            a_i = int(input[index])
            x_i = int(input[index + 1])
            index += 2
            for j in range(a_i):
                sequence[j] += x_i
                total_sum += x_i
        elif operation == 2:
            k_i = int(input[index])
            index += 1
            sequence.append(k_i)
            total_sum += k_i
        elif operation == 3:
            removed_value = sequence.pop()
            total_sum -= removed_value

        avg = total_sum / len(sequence)
        results.append(f"{avg:.6f}")

    print("\n".join(results))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
